Contact

We’d love to hear from you

Have a question about membership, want to visit a meeting, or just want to say hello? Send us a note with the form, or email us any time at inquiry@needleworkguildmn.org — we read every message and will get back to you soon.

Send us a message

Fill in a few details and we’ll be in touch.

Volunteer board

Reach the right person

The Guild is run entirely by volunteer members. Each role has its own email — write to the one closest to your question and it’ll reach the right person. Not sure who to write? Email inquiry@needleworkguildmn.org and we’ll point you the right way.

Where we meet

Most groups meet at Minnesota Valley Unitarian Universalist Fellowship (MVUUF) in Bloomington. A few gather in members' homes or meet online — check the individual meeting for where it's held.

Joining by video

Many of our meetings are on Zoom, in whole or in part. The link is available to members, and if you’re not a member yet, just request it — we’ll be happy to email it to you.

Join

Find your people
and your stitching

We'd love to have you. Come sit in on a Stitch-In, or any of our other monthly meetings — in person or on Zoom, whichever fits your calendar. Try as many as you're curious about. Once you've found the one (or three) that feel like yours, join us for just $30 a year.
